evidence.table_header: | Instance size | Sustained performance (MBps) for ingress | Maximum quota (MBps) for ingress | Sustained performance (MBps) for egress | Maximum quota (MBps) for egress |

evidence.quote: In this table, the recommended throughput is represented as Sustained performance, which is the threshold up to which your applications won't experience any performance degradation.
Maximum quota is the threshold at which your cluster will throttle read/write traffic.
